verdict.rationale: Kintsugi markets full-service registration ('registers you, and files everywhere you sell') and exposes a Create Registration API plus Get Filings API for status tracking, and a nexus-detection workflow to trigger registrations. However, there is no evidence of transparent per-registration pricing, and no detail on how state/local filing execution is handled operationally beyond API objects. Missing for 10: explicit per-registration pricing disclosure, concrete proof of state-by-state filing execution (not just API scaffolding), and independent/customer confirmation of the service being fully white-glove.
